description: Records a pair of tools from two MCP connectors of the same AI gateway where one tool can shadow the other: the names collide or look alike, or the text of one tool refers to the other.

ID.description: ID is the identifier of the object.
ID.title: ID

connectorA.description: The name of the first connector of the pair. For a cross reference, it is the connector of the tool whose text refers to the other tool.
connectorA.title: connectorA

connectorB.description: The name of the second connector of the pair.
connectorB.title: connectorB

detail.description: What triggered the finding, such as the edit distance between the two names or the text that refers to the other tool.
detail.title: detail

firstDetectedAt.description: When the pair was first detected.
firstDetectedAt.title: firstDetectedAt

gatewayName.description: The name of the AI gateway exposing both tools.
gatewayName.title: gatewayName

mcpServerA.description: The name of the MCP server behind connector A.
mcpServerA.title: mcpServerA

mcpServerB.description: The name of the MCP server behind connector B.
mcpServerB.title: mcpServerB

signal.description: The rule that detected the pair. ExactNameCollision: both tools have the same name, ignoring case and spaces. ConfusableName: the names are the same once look-alike characters are mapped to Latin letters. NearDuplicateName: the names differ by a few characters. CrossReference: the text of tool A contains the name of tool B or of the MCP server of connector B.
signal.title: signal

sourceA.description: Where tool A comes from. Baseline: it is the same as the tool in the provider tool list of connector A. Changed: it is not in that list or it differs from it, so the MCP server added or changed it after the list was set. NotApplicable: there is no tool A, or the provider tool list of connector A could not be found.
sourceA.title: sourceA

sourceB.description: Where tool B comes from. Baseline: it is the same as the tool in the provider tool list of connector B. Changed: it is not in that list or it differs from it, so the MCP server added or changed it after the list was set. NotApplicable: there is no tool B, or the provider tool list of connector B could not be found.
sourceB.title: sourceB

toolA.description: The name of the tool on connector A, without the gateway prefix.
toolA.title: toolA

toolB.description: The name of the tool on connector B, without the gateway prefix. Empty when tool A refers to the MCP server of connector B rather than to one of its tools.
toolB.title: toolB

updateTime.description: Last update date of the object.
updateTime.title: updateTime

title: MCPToolShadowFinding
